popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus makes Protogeneia daughter of Deucalion and Pyrrha, loved by Zeus, mother of Aethlius — the flood line tied to the Elean kings.

popCulture.title: Protogeneia
popCulture.description: First-born daughter of the flood survivors — by Zeus mother of Aethlius, stem of Endymion and the Elean royal house.

popCulture.title: Deucalion
popCulture.description: Protogeneia's father — the survivor whose children reseeds Hellas after Zeus' deluge.

popCulture.title: Aethlius
popCulture.description: Protogeneia's son by Zeus — first king of Elis in the stemma that leads to Endymion.
